Load an image to get started

CutOut performs powerful image segmentation by using cutting edge practical research. The application performs a scribble-based segmentation algorithm for extracting object from natrual photos and pasting them seamlessly into a different background.

 Carried out by Elad Richardson, Anastasia Dubrovina and Prof. Ron Kimmel from the Technion's GIP lab. Additional technical supervision was provided by Aaron Wetzler. 
 The app interface and logo were designed with the help of Michal Hendel.
Draw a scribble inside the object that you want to cut out.\n A simple line should be enough, but be sure not to get out of the boundaries.
Draw a scribble outside the object that you want to cut out.\n The application will then display an outline around the object.
If the outline is not precise you can easily add more scribbles.
Once you are happy with the result, click the V to confirm.
